A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the elastic response of a granular material to fluid injection is relatively insensitive to the presence of plasticity and the material permeability, while the plastic response is highly sensitive to these factors.
the poroelastic model is a good approximation for the elastic region but that plasticity must be considered for large deformations.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the transition from impermable to permeable is an important consideration in geomechanics, and that plasticity should always be included in models of fluid injection into the subsurface.
the large deformations of granular materials are sensitive to model choice.
